description: HanaAgent - a personal AI agent with memory and soul

installer.script: 7z x "-o$dir\.cache" "$dir\$fname" -y | Out-Null; $inner = Get-ChildItem -Path "$dir\.cache" -Recurse -Filter "app-64.7z" | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $inner) { throw "Inner app archive (app-64.7z) not found inside NSIS payload" }; 7z x "-o$dir" $inner.FullName -y | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$dir\.cache", "$dir\$fname"

shortcuts: HanaAgent - a personal AI agent with memory and soul
